title: AGENTS.md should stay principle-only
observation: When adding a self-improvement loop, the top-level guide should link outward instead of absorbing examples and heuristics.
impact: Keeping AGENTS.md short makes it easier to re-read before every task and reduces accidental rule drift.
candidate_rule: Promote only stable cross-cutting rules into AGENTS.md, and move detail into skills, references, or learnings.
evidence: Existing Tulpa skills already separate SKILL.md from references/.
The repository's top-level agent guidance is read frequently and should remain scannable.
